question: For the paper "Different Absorption from the Same Sharing: Sifted Multi-task Learning for Fake News Detection" (arXiv: 1909.01720), answer this question: What are the hyperparameter setting of the MTL model?

requirements.subject: MTL model

assessment.supported_part: 论文给出了MTL模型（本文方法）的超参数设置：词嵌入和位置嵌入大小为200和100，transformer编码器中注意力头数为6、块数为2，多头注意力dropout为0.7，minibatch大小为64，初始学习率为0.001，dropout率为0.3，任务权重λ为0.6（用于假新闻检测任务），任务数N=2；超参数通过在验证集上的小网格搜索调优。

evidence.quote: The sizes of word embeddings and position embeddings are set to 200 and 100. passages.text: 3.2 Shared-private Feature Extractor Shared-private feature extractor is mainly used for extracting shared features and private features among different tasks. In this paper, we apply the encoder module of transformer (Vaswani et al., 2017) (henceforth, transformer encoder) to the shared-private extractor of our model. Specially, we employ two transformer encoders to encode the input embeddings of the two tasks as their respec- tive private features.

passages.text: In summary, the contributions of this paper are as follows: • We explore a selected sharing layer relying on gate mechanism and attention mechanism, which can selectively capture valuable shared features between tasks of fake news detection and stance detection for respective tasks. • The transformer encoder is introduced into our model for encoding inputs of both tasks, which enhances the performance of our method by taking advantages of its long-range dependencies and parallelism.
